why_this_data.value: Edge-on CND increases sensitivity to thickness differences among gas phases

evidence.quote: The circumnuclear disk (CND) of NGC 5506 is viewed at a nearly edge-on inclination, which enhances the sensitivity to differences in geometrical thickness among multiple gas phases.

why_this_method.value: Briggs robust tuned so all three lines have comparable beams, since thicknesses are compared

evidence.quote: Because this study compares geometrical thicknesses among different gas phases, the Briggs `robust` parameter was adjusted to synthesize comparable beam sizes across all three lines.

alternatives_considered_or_rejected.value: AGN X-ray irradiation likely contributes to CO dissociation but cannot explain the nonaxisymmetric distribution of elevated [C I]/CO, so the outflow-interaction scenario is favoured

evidence.quote: it cannot account for the nonaxisymmetric distribution of the elevated $R_{\rm [C~I]/CO}$ regions.

alternatives_considered_or_rejected.value: Radiation-driven fountain flow likely not stably established in NGC 5506 given its Eddington ratio and BH mass

evidence.quote: suggest that a stable radiation-driven fountain flow may not be established.
Throughout this paper, error values represent only statistical uncertainties unless otherwise noted.

limitations_admitted.value: HST [O III] dataset covers only the northern side of the emission; southern cone undetected

evidence.quote: The dataset covers only the northern side of the emission (cite: Ruiz2005).

limitations_admitted.value: Agreement between model v_t and observed Vdisp is less robust away from 100 pc

evidence.quote: the agreement between $v_{\rm t}$ and $V_{\rm disp}$ is less robust at radii other than 100 pc.

referee_caveats_inferred: Vdisp/Vrot as H/R proxy ignores beam smearing, inclination (79 deg) mixing and non-thermal/non-circular motions; no beam-smearing test is described
Conclusions on [C I] vs CO thickness rely on matched beams tuned by robust, which gives different uv weighting per line (Band 8 vs Band 7 sampling) and may bias thickness
Single-trial Vout grid with coarse 10 km/s steps and ~5 km/s uncertainty; model-dependent
Line ratio inside/outside bicone depends on HST registration (0.2 arcsec) and FOC covering only the northern cone
Model comparison with Kawakatu et al. 2020 is order-of-magnitude with large BH mass and SFR uncertainties (BH mass spans a factor ~10)
CO(3-2) mass assumes alpha_CO = 0.8 and thermalised CO(3-2)/CO(2-1); no uncertainty propagated from alpha_CO

data_public_as_stated.value: HST data in MAST; ALMA CO and HCO+ data are archival Band 7 (project 2017.1.00082.S); Band 8 data are from project 2022.1.00410.S (public status not stated)

evidence.quote: CO(3–2) and HCO$^{+}$(4–3) were obtained from archival Band 7 observations.
*HST* data analyzed in this paper can be found in MASTat .

missing_for_reproduction: tclean parameters beyond robust, nsigma and channel width (cell size, imsize, spw/rest frequency, niter, other automasking settings)
3D Barolo configuration and version, and how uncertainties are derived
Definition of the bicone mask and the HST-to-ALMA registration used for the line-ratio regions
Moment-map integration ranges and noise estimates
reproducibility.estimated_data_volume_inferred: Roughly 50-200 GB of raw ALMA data across the two projects; calibrated cubes a few GB
reproducibility.score_reason: Data projects and key imaging parameters (robust, nsigma, 20 km/s channels, CASA 6.5.6) and Barolo setup are given with numeric results, but many tclean, continuum subtraction and mask details are missing and Band 8 data status is not stated.
reproducibility.rediscovery_reason: Public status of the Cycle 9 Band 8 data is not stated and several imaging and Barolo settings are missing, so the recipe is not complete enough to redo the main results.
